metaDesc: Awakening to the multidimensionality of Being: the mission of a galactic soul on the ground, guiding the shift of consciousness from 3D to 5D.
h1: Awakening to the multidimensionality of Being
lede: “It is time to merge Essence-sky into Existence-Sky.” The life experience of a galactic soul on the ground.
bannerAlt: Consciousness shifting into the fifth dimension
s1p1: Our galaxy is crossing a photon belt and many portals. Our world oscillates between different, interpenetrating space-time trajectories, allowing journeys through space-time.
s1p2: On this exceptional jewel called Earth, within the same 3D setting, Souls of different natures and levels of consciousness, and technological beings, move about wearing the same human costume.
s2Quote: An unprecedented period offers an opportunity for incredible evolution, the reason for our decision to incarnate: becoming conscious of, and integrating through experience, the shift of the Being's consciousness from 3D to 5D in the most difficult of contexts.
s2Matrix: See the film The Matrix, which shows us a certain reality!
points: Within a Matrix of confinement and manipulation of consciousness, set up on Earth thousands of years ago by non-human involutive beings.
Within a programme to infiltrate and replace a humanity with a race in search of bodies, determined to seize the most precious gift the Creator gave to His Creation: the Soul.
With the veil of forgetting WHO I AM and the Soul disconnected by the severing of ten strands of DNA.
pioneerIntro: Experiencing a DNA in the process of mutation, for the fullest reconnection with the spiritual Being that we are.
pioneerQuotes: "Your experience is unique in the galaxy and will serve as a model for others."
"You will become the teachers of the young souls of this planet."
"You are precious. You are the ancestors of the future."
pioneerP2: … say the Inner-Earth and Extraterrestrial beings I have been communicating with telepathically for more than a decade.
pioneerAdn: “This new DNA will serve as the source-base for the creation of future galactic and intergalactic races.”
pioneerP3: This initiatory process consists in merging the Ego with the Soul at your own physical, psychic and psychological pace; for it is the Soul that ascends, not the human personality.
callLede: This teaching is meant above all for two crews, and you are part of them.

crewOld.title: “Old Souls”
crewOld.desc: The galactic team on the ground for thousands of years, now reconnecting with the I AM Presence for the end of the mission.

crewYoung.title: “Young galactic Souls”
crewYoung.desc: Arrived in the last few decades, now anchoring and re-membering the programme to bring the mission to fruition.
